description: This file contains utility functions and data classes for JSON parsing, color handling, error processing, and key normalization used within the ai.openclaw.app.node package. It provides helper methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, color parsing, error extraction, and key validation, tailored for internal application logic.

classes.name: Quad
classes.description: A generic data class representing a tuple of four elements, used for holding four related data items.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON-compatible string with proper escaping.

methods.name: asObjectOrNull
methods.description: Safely casts a JsonElement to JsonObject or returns null if not possible.

methods.name: parseJsonParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, returning null if parsing fails or input is invalid.

methods.name: readJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Extracts a JsonPrimitive from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from a JsonObject by key if present and valid.

methods.name: parseJsonDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double value from a JsonObject by key if present and valid.

methods.name: parseJsonString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a JsonObject by key if present.

methods.name: parseJsonBooleanFlag
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from a JsonObject by key based on string content.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JsonElement to a String or null if not applicable.

methods.name: parseHexColorArgb
methods.description: Parses a hex color string into a Long ARGB value, supporting formats with '#' prefix.

methods.name: invokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Extracts an error code and message from a Throwable, using an external parser to interpret the error.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims whitespace and nullifies empty strings for main key input.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key equals 'main', indicating a canonical main session key.
